title: 8. Fachtagung MOBILE MACHINES – Sicherheit und Fahrerassistenz für Arbeitsmaschinen : 18. Februar 2025, Karlsruhe

creators.name: Wissenschaftlicher Verein für Mobile Arbeitsmaschinen, WVMA

bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The book contains the conference proceedings of the 8th symposium MOBILE MACHINES on February 18, 2025 in Karlsruhe. Ten papers report on the state of research and development in the field of mobile machinery. The papers deal in particular with the topics of assistance systems, safety and security as well as process data management and networking in the context of mobile machines.
